qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (full; 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps')
evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS CARRY THE REAL GATE. scoring.toml:1-3 '[gates] render = 0.0 / constraints = 0.0'; both gate judge.toml use aggregation = "all_pass" with one binary criterion; score.py:41 'gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor ...)' and :48 reward 0.0 unless gates_passed. (a) Render gate (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:25, hro_gate_render): wrong password leaves visitor signed out (negative), then correct Recruiter password signs in to 'a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' - this is the auth leg with its positive control (render prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'). (b) Constraints gate (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25, hro_gate_shared): add a candidate via ordinary UI to the seeded Data Analyst job, reload (still signed in, card still there), then in a new independent browser context sign in as Observer and find exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate.' prompt.md:9 forbids API-only writes and gives a working independent-context recipe. This is the backing leg the REVIEW_POLICY asks for ('actual successful operation and independent-context readback'), and it matches Colderwater lesson 4 (load, reload, server-backed only; strictness lives in scored criteria - render explicitly says 'Permissions and workspace rules belong to scored outcomes', constraints says 'Do not grade job opening, stage rules, conversations or live updates here'). Public requirements behind every gate leg: add candidate with name/email/source, new card at bottom of Applied (hireops_rules.md:32-33); Recruiters add candidates and move on any job (hireops_rules.md:17,70); Observer reads the board (:19); seeded 'Data Analyst' job exists (seed_data.json JOB-DATA); accounts/password in instruction.md:19 and app_context.md:8-19. EVERY SCORED PROMPT RESTATES THE IN-DIMENSION GATE AND HARD-ZEROS. functional/prompt.md:9-13 '## Global browser gate ...' same backing check, then 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0' (functional has 44/44 binary criteria); polish/prompt.md:9-12 same check, 'gives binary0 throughout' (5/5 binary); visual/prompt.md:9-12 same check, 'gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero' (5/5 likert). No scored prompt assigns partial credit on gate failure (quality-checks.md #29 defect absent). Each scored gate implicitly includes the auth leg (sign in as Rafael, then Observer in a fresh context). NO SAME-ORIGIN REQUIREMENT. Case-insensitive grep for 'origin' across task tests/ finds only 'original successful move' (functional/judge.toml:211); no gate or prompt requires same-origin, local-only assets or blocks CDN; the task's replay rules use 'page.evaluate fetch or context request' with no own-origin restriction. Lesson 13: gates use only http://localhost:3000; no public internet address. TRY A BROKEN APP THAT COULD PASS: (1) localStorage-only app - fails the independent-context Observer readback; (2) static mock/seed copy - fails (new unique card must appear in another context); (3) app with no real auth (any password accepted) - fails render's wrong-password leg; (4) server keeping data only in process memory - passes the gates, but that is correct for a gate (durability is graded in Functional with restart_app and the functional floor 0.05 limits a dead-rest app); (5) app whose add-candidate works but everything else is dead - passes gates, then near-zero scored + functional floor, which is the intended shaped design. TRY A CONFORMING ALTERNATIVE THAT COULD FAIL: card shown somewhere other than Applied - not conforming (rules :33); Observer lacking a board view - not conforming (rules :19), and the gate also accepts 'another working staff account'; source as a fixed dropdown - gate says 'any source'; strict email validation - judge uses a unique well-formed address. One residual: the gate's 'Reload the page: the visitor is still signed in' is not stated in one literal sentence; it is strongly implied by hireops_rules.md:175-176 (draft survives 'after I reload the page, and after my session ends' - reload is distinguished from session end) and instruction.md:13 ('reload, and make sure nothing breaks'). I judge this an implied public requirement, not a hidden one, but note it. RUNTIME: raw-evidence-index scope states 'Full configured grading/workload ... and Oracle/target scores are absent.' The scripted golden (hashes verified) records {'name': 'gate: a candidate added to a seeded job survives a reload and is read back by the Observer in another context', 'passed': True} - scripted Playwright, not the configured judge. The browser_run_code_unsafe tool name the constraints/scored gates rely on is asserted by scripts/check_hireops_mcp.cjs:75 but I did not read its output for @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (tests/Dockerfile:19), so tool feasibility under the shipped judge is not re-measured by me. Risk is true only because no configured judge run of the gate dimensions (golden or weak app) exists; no source defect found for this row.
